findings.evidence: The paper reports "95% confidence" intervals, but the code computes the interval with 5%/95% bounds (`confidence_lower = sorted_scores[int(0.05 * len(sorted_scores))]`) (and 1 similar line(s)), which is a 90% interval; no 2.5%/97.5% bounds appear anywhere in the code. Check whether the reported intervals are 90% intervals.

One of them is the wrong file. Same pattern at 1 more place(s): run.ipynb code cell 14 line 9.

(l1 = 0.01); the code sets `alpha=0.005` at code/GC-diagnosis-model/run.ipynb:94 (l1 = 0.005). Same parameter, different value.
